#  A receipt says a review was CONVENED and recorded against the commit it reviewed.

#  old single column was green for any value of the question that matters, which is the
#  `constblind` shape exactly.  Both numbers are now recorded, and seats-READ is the one
#  that means anything: a panel is not complete when its seats have answered, only when
#  they have been read.  Backfilled honestly, including where the honest answer is 1of9.
